def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(input[0])
    rounds = input[1:]

    scores = {}
    cumulative = []
    max_score = 0
    winner = None

    for line in rounds:
        name, score = line.split()
        score = int(score)
        if name not in scores:
            scores[name] = 0
        scores[name] += score
        cumulative.append((name, scores[name]))

    if not cumulative:
        return

    max_score = max(scores.values())
    max_players = [name for name in scores if scores[name] == max_score]

    if len(max_players) == 1:
        winner = max_players[0]
    else:
        for name, score in cumulative:
            if score >= max_score and name in max_players:
                winner = name
                break

    print(winner)
